news.title: Hesai Stock In Focus After $100 Million Share Buyback Plan

gap_raw.name: Any gap up on heavy volume
gap_raw.why: The old backtest: buy every 8%+ gap on 3× volume. Kept only as a yardstick.
gap_raw.exitName: Trailing stop 2.5× the daily range, up to 20 days

verdict.label: Positive on unseen data, not proven yet

gap_hold.name: Gap up that holds
gap_hold.why: An 8–50% gap on 3× volume that closes above its open and in the top third of the day: buyers kept control all day. 50%+ gaps are left out (they fade most).
gap_hold.exitName: Trailing stop 2.5× the daily range, up to 20 days

verdict.label: Lost on unseen data: switched off

quiet_volume.name: Quiet volume spike
quiet_volume.why: Dollar volume 2.5× its 50-day average while the price barely moves (0 to +3%): big buyers getting in quietly before a move. Stocks with unusual volume tend to rise afterwards (Gervais, Kaniel & Mingelgrin, Journal of Finance 2001).
quiet_volume.exitName: Half at +10%, rest at +20%, stop under support, 10 days

verdict.label: Lost on unseen data: switched off

high_52w.name: 52-week high breakout
high_52w.why: First close above the 52-week high on 1.5× volume. Stocks at their 52-week high keep beating the market for months (George & Hwang, Journal of Finance 2004).

verdict.label: Lost on unseen data: switched off

insider_cluster.name: Insider cluster buy
insider_cluster.why: Two or more directors or officers buying their own shares on the open market within 10 days, $100k+ in total (SEC Form 4). Clustered and non-routine insider buys have beaten the market (Alldredge & Blank; Cohen, Malloy & Pomorski).
insider_cluster.exitName: Trailing stop 2.5× the daily range, up to 20 days

verdict.label: Lost on unseen data: switched off

insider_big.name: Big insider buy
insider_big.why: One director or officer buying $250k+ of their own shares on the open market (not a pre-planned 10b5-1 trade). Bigger buys by senior people carry more information (Lakonishok & Lee).
insider_big.exitName: Trailing stop 2.5× the daily range, up to 20 days

verdict.label: Positive on unseen data, not proven yet

activist_13d.name: New 13D: a big investor crosses 5%
activist_13d.why: A new Schedule 13D: someone now owns 5%+ and has plans for the company. Around +7% vs the market in the 20 days around the filing, most of it after it is public, with no later reversal (Brav, Jiang, Partnoy & Thomas 2008; Bebchuk, Brav & Jiang).
activist_13d.exitName: Trailing stop 2.5× the daily range, up to 20 days

verdict.label: Lost on unseen data: switched off
